ImageDescription.value: Ground-level interior view of The Arcade (Cleveland), looking down the length of the five-story atrium in warm incandescent light. Tenant storefronts occupy the street level on both sides, including a fitness center on the left and a United States Postal Service location on the right. Ornate cast iron lamp standards and string lights line the central corridor. Two visitors walk in the middle distance. Multiple levels of iron-railed balconies rise on both sides beneath the arched glass skylight, with a large American flag suspended in the middle distance. The terrazzo floor reflects the ambient lighting.
